content.name: Sky toolkit v0 (ciel constitutionnel — constellations de villes)
content.lineage: Shares the Micro-energy circuit toolkit's AtomDynamics vocabulary (the 'micro-electric' kit), but physicalized in the SKY: atoms are stars, support bonds are constellation lines, measured support is luminosity. It is the celestial pole of the Underground toolkit — the Underground seals the immutable substrate BENEATH the city; the Sky raises the city's constitution ABOVE it, legible from everywhere. See [[space:l2:mind-universe:underground-toolkit-v0]].

parent_scope.justification: Portable bootstrap toolkit awaiting installation under the canonical civic/physicalization registry Space. Exactly one scope classification; no PART_OF edge is written to an unbuilt parent.

content.native_law_boundary: AtomDynamics knows only AtomSpec, AtomBond and support/inhibit/neutral. The Sky is a physicalization grammar and a CAPABILITY boundary; it adds no predicate meaning to the native law. Luminosity is a rendering of measured support energy; whether an article may be amended is authorization data on the amendment port, never a term in the atom law.
content.purpose: Encode each city's constitution in the sky as a constellation of luminous, interconnected articles. Every constitutional article is a Star whose brightness is its MEASURED ratification; every constitutional relation is a Constellation line; the founding article (the End Game the city was planted to preserve) is the Pole Star, aligned above the civic-origin beacon. The constitution is visible from anywhere in the city and readable by every citizen, but a citizen may only look up: adding, altering or removing a star or a line is a constitutional-authority act, never a private gesture.

sky_contract.star: one constitutional article, physicalized as a luminous point whose brightness = measured ratification energy
sky_contract.constellation_line: one constitutional relation (depends-on, derives-from, amends) between two articles, physicalized as a drawn line of light
sky_contract.pole_star: the founding article / End Game; the brightest, the orientation anchor; sits directly above the civic-origin beacon so the sky and the ground share one zero
sky_contract.rule: A star shines only when its ratification support is present and MEASURED; an unratified or unknown article renders as Fog (dark), never as a bright star. An amendment is admitted only from a constitutional-authority capability; an unauthorized amendment fails closed, leaves the sky exactly as it was, and is reported.

content.success_condition: For every city, its constitution is legible as a constellation from any point in the city: each ratified article is a Star whose brightness is its measured ratification, each constitutional relation is a Constellation line, and the founding article is the Pole Star aligned above the civic origin. No citizen gesture ever adds, alters or removes a star or line; an unratified article is Fog (dark), never a fabricated bright star; and the sky's structure always matches the committed constitution graph.

content.pattern: A bounded Sky dome vaults over the city and carries no energy of its own. Constitutional articles physicalize as Stars — atoms of roleAxis narrative (attractors that hold light); the founding article is the Pole Star, an actor-roleAxis source that is ratified first and lights the constellation. Constitutional relations physicalize as Constellation lines — support bonds that carry luminosity from one star to the next. A star's brightness is a faithful render of its MEASURED ratification support; below threshold it is dim, unratified it is Fog. Access is split into two strictly separate surfaces: anyone on the ground may READ the sky (observe, trace lineage, orient by the Pole Star); only a constitutional authority may AMEND it (ratify, add a star, draw or sever a line).
content.epistemic_honesty: A bright star is a ratified article, not a wished-for one. A drawn line is a committed constitutional relation, not a visual convenience. A dim or dark region is Fog — an unratified or unknown article — never rendered as confident law. Looking up is not amending; the sky is unreachable from the ground.

terms.SkyDome: The bounded Space that vaults over one city; roleAxis space, carries no energy, bounds the constellation.
terms.Star: One constitutional article physicalized as a luminous point. Its brightness is a render of its measured ratification support; it shines only when that support meets the ratification threshold.
terms.PoleStar: The founding article — the End Game the city was planted to preserve. The brightest star and the orientation anchor; positioned directly above the civic-origin beacon so sky and ground share one zero.
terms.ConstellationLine: One constitutional relation (depends-on, derives-from, amends) between two articles, physicalized as a support bond drawn as a line of light. It exists only where a committed constitutional relation exists.
terms.Luminosity: The rendered brightness of a star = its measured ratification energy. Never invented; unmeasured ratification renders as Fog.
terms.Ratification: The measured support that lights an article. An article with insufficient or unknown ratification does not shine.
terms.Constitution: The connected graph of a city's articles and their relations — the constellation as a whole.
terms.Fog: An unratified, unknown or not_measured article; rendered as dark sky, never as a bright star.
terms.AmendmentPort: The single mutation surface of the sky. Resolves to a required constitutional-authority capability; a citizen holds none. Fails closed for the unauthorized.
terms.ConstitutionalAuthority: The capability required to ratify, add, alter, sever or supersede a constitutional article. Held by a constitutional convention / Genesis authority, not by ordinary citizens.

content.given: A city's committed constitution (articles + relations), measured ratification per article, the civic-origin beacon pose, a visual catalog, and the acting actor's capability set.
content.when: The runtime renders the sky, a citizen looks up to read the constitution, or any actor issues an amendment (ratify / add star / draw or sever line / supersede article).
then: Physicalize the constitution as a constellation: one Star per article, one Constellation line per committed relation, the founding article as the Pole Star above the civic origin.
Render each star's brightness as a faithful projection of its MEASURED ratification; below threshold dim, unratified Fog (dark).
Serve every read request as observe-only: the citizen sees stars, lines, brightness and lineage, and is offered no amendment affordance.
Resolve every amendment against the required constitutional-authority capability; admit it only for an actor that holds it.
Fail an unauthorized amendment closed, leave the sky exactly as it was, and emit a rejection receipt.
forbidden: reading predicate names inside the native AtomDynamics law
rendering an unratified, unknown or not_measured article as a bright star (fabricated luminosity)
drawing a Constellation line where no committed constitutional relation exists
offering, to an actor without the constitutional-authority capability, any affordance that adds, alters, removes a star or draws/severs a line
letting the act of looking up widen an actor's capability
streaming authored, derived, unknown or not_measured luminosity
moving the Pole Star off the civic-origin axis so sky and ground disagree on zero
presenting a renderer twinkle as a committed ratification
silently dropping an unauthorized amendment instead of failing it closed with a receipt

steps: read the city's committed constitution graph (articles + relations) and per-article measured ratification
validate exact u64 AtomSpec/AtomBond invariants for the star circuit
admit only measured ratification energy through the membrane
seat the Pole Star (founding article) on the civic-origin axis, ratified first
light each star whose measured ratification meets its threshold; hold the rest as Fog
conduct luminosity along each Constellation line once, from ratified article to dependent article
verify admitted integer luminosity is conserved
for a read: resolve the observe-only affordance set and render brightness without inventing luminosity
for an amendment: resolve the required constitutional-authority capability, admit only if held, else fail closed and leave the sky unchanged
emit the commit or rejection receipt
run the independent observer and the structured evaluation AST
derive health from fresh validation evidence
content.capability_resolution: read -> observe-only-set; amendment_port -> require(constitutional_authority_capability). No affordance escalates capability; an absent capability fails closed, never a silent amendment.
content.scheduler_projection: deterministic-wave-ticks/1; exact same-tick tie semantics must be reconciled with the canonical Rust crate when integrated.

content.authority: Graph-native CodeDefinition projection for the portable Sky toolkit; this JSON file is a materialized projection, not independent semantic authority.

amendment_gate.rule: An amendment is admitted only when the acting capability set contains authority:constitutional-convention. Looking up grants none of it.

star_circuit.note: Illustrative shape: the founding article is the seeded Pole Star; ratification supports light each article; constellation lines conduct luminosity to dependents. Concrete per-city articles are supplied by the city's constitution graph at render time, not hard-coded here.

content.honesty: The portable Sky toolkit is materialized and structurally shaped as a construct. This field is written BEFORE injection; after an injector commits it, the on-disk graph carries the construct while this embedded field reads stale (WRITTEN but not wired, executed, or proven healthy). No constellation is rendered and no ratification is measured yet.

why: A constitution that lives only in a document is easy to forget and hard to orient by; raised into the sky as a constellation it is visible from everywhere and becomes the shared reference every citizen can point at.

Making brightness the render of MEASURED ratification means the sky cannot flatter the constitution: an un-ratified article stays dark, so the difference between aspiration and law is legible at a glance.
Encoding relations as constellation lines makes the constitution's structure — what derives from what, what amends what — readable as a shape, not just a list.
Aligning the Pole Star above the civic-origin beacon ties the constitution (sky) to the founding act (ground) so the city has one zero, above and below.

Gating amendment behind a constitutional-authority capability, enforced at admission, keeps the constitution amendable by the right body and unreachable to a private gesture — the same capability discipline as the Underground, mirrored above.
rejected: a constitution stored only as text, because it is invisible from the world and cannot be oriented by
brightness from authored or wished-for status, because that would let the sky show law that was never ratified
decorative constellation lines, because a line that means nothing turns the sky into ornament
letting citizens edit the sky, because the constitution would then be a private canvas, not a shared law
floating-point luminosity, because the canonical law counts conserved integer energy
health inferred from a twinkling renderer, because animation is not ratification

negative_invariants: neutral bond with nonzero energy rejected
amend affordance offered to non-authority rejected
invariants: every amend affordance resolves to a required constitutional-authority capability
a read grants exactly the observe-only set
looking up never changes the acting capability set
an unauthorized amendment fails closed and leaves the sky exactly as it was
a star shines only with measured ratification at or above threshold
a Constellation line exists iff a committed constitutional relation exists
the Pole Star is aligned above the civic origin
not_measured ratification renders as Fog, never as brightness

tests: detect a bright star whose article is not ratified (fabricated luminosity)
detect a Constellation line with no committed constitutional relation
detect an amend affordance offered to an actor without the authority capability
detect a read that widened capability
detect an unauthorized amendment that changed the sky
detect an unauthorized amendment dropped without a rejection receipt
detect a Pole Star off the civic-origin axis
detect a missing or invalid receipt
never convert an unratified article into a bright star

content.independence: Reads the city's committed constitution graph, per-article measured ratification, the physicalized star event trace, final star states, the civic-origin beacon pose, the acting capability set, each resolved affordance, the commit/rejection receipt and the catalog. It does not trust a runtime-declared health field, a renderer twinkle, or an implementation self-report of ratification.
checks: every star's brightness matches its measured ratification (no fabricated luminosity)
every Constellation line corresponds to a committed constitutional relation
no committed relation is missing its line
the Pole Star aligns with the civic-origin beacon
every amend affordance requires the constitutional-authority capability
read affordance sets contain observe-only capabilities
looking up leaves the acting capability set unchanged
unauthorized amendment failed closed and left the sky unchanged
rejected amendment produced a rejection receipt and no sky delta

derivation.healthy: All required fresh validation scenarios pass: every star's brightness matched its measured ratification, every Constellation line matched a committed relation, the Pole Star aligned with the civic origin, every amendment was authority-gated, every unauthorized amendment failed closed leaving the sky unchanged, and no unratified article was rendered bright.
derivation.degraded: Fresh evidence exists but at least one non-catastrophic dimension violates its bound.
derivation.stale: The latest otherwise valid evidence exceeds the configured freshness window.
derivation.unknown: Required evidence cannot be resolved to a known state.
derivation.not_measured: No fresh validation run has measured the required dimensions.
derivation.measurement_failed: The observer or evaluator failed to produce a trustworthy measurement.

content.name: Constitutional amendment port (sky mutation)
content.note: Reading the sky (from anywhere on the ground) is a separate observe-only surface; this port is the ONLY amendment surface and it requires the constitutional-authority capability.
